lines.zh: 巢口的沙被我们踩成一条路。
lines.en: Our feet have worn the sand at the nest mouth into a road.

lines.zh: 翅膀贴着隧道壁，一路擦出细响。
lines.en: My wings scrape the tunnel wall, a thin hiss the whole way.

lines.zh: 我走的是气味留下的那条线。
lines.en: I follow the line the scent left behind.

lines.zh: 队尾跟着队首，中间不留缝。
lines.en: The last follows the first, with no gap between.

lines.zh: 沙子底下有回音，我顺着回音走。
lines.en: There is an echo under the sand, and I walk along it.

lines.zh: 这一趟只走半程，剩下的交给后面的。
lines.en: I walk only half this trip; the rest is theirs.

lines.zh: 隧道拐角处，我数了数身边的同伴。
lines.en: At the tunnel's turn I count the kin beside me.

lines.zh: 我的六只脚同时落地，声音像一场小雨。
lines.en: Six feet land together, like a small rain.

lines.zh: 前面那只停，我就停。
lines.en: When the one ahead stops, I stop.

lines.zh: 从保育室到粮仓，我闭着眼也不会迷路。
lines.en: Nursery to food store, I could not get lost blind.

lines.zh: 影子在沙面上移动，比身体快一步。
lines.en: My shadow moves on the sand, one step ahead of me.

lines.zh: 我们不走直线，直线容易被看见。
lines.en: We never walk straight; straight lines get seen.

lines.zh: 静止的时候，巢里的声音更清楚。
lines.en: When I am still, the hive is louder.

lines.zh: 我用触角敲了敲墙壁，等回音。
lines.en: I tap the wall with my antennae and wait for an answer.

lines.zh: 没有命令下来，我就原地待着。
lines.en: No order comes down, so I stay where I am.

lines.zh: 沙粒落进颈后的缝里，我抖了抖。
lines.en: Sand falls into the seam behind my neck; I shake it off.

lines.zh: 我在等一个不属于我的名字。
lines.en: I am waiting for a name that was never mine.

lines.zh: 同伴爬过我的背，算是打了招呼。
lines.en: A kin crawls over my back; that counts as a greeting.

lines.zh: 巢穴深处传来震动，那是另一层在动。
lines.en: A tremor from deep in the hive means another floor is moving.

lines.zh: 我数着呼吸，一直数到下一次震动。
lines.en: I count my breaths until the next tremor.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀收起来时，几乎看不见。
lines.en: Folded, my wings are almost invisible.

lines.zh: 这一格沙是温的，下面有东西在活动。
lines.en: This patch of sand is warm; something moves beneath it.

lines.zh: 蜂蚁没有单独的巢室，我靠墙站着。
lines.en: Swarmers get no chamber of their own; I stand by the wall.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，我能听见自己的关节响。
lines.en: In the quiet I can hear my own joints creak.

lines.zh: 有东西在隧道尽头转身，我没有动。
lines.en: Something turns at the tunnel's end; I do not move.

lines.zh: 我记不住自己的编号，只记得气味。
lines.en: I cannot recall my number, only the smell.

lines.zh: 你站着不动，我就一直看着。
lines.en: Stand still and I will keep watching.

lines.zh: 你身上有巢外的味道，很新。
lines.en: You carry the outside smell, and it is fresh.

lines.zh: 我在数你身上有几处会动的地方。
lines.en: I am counting the parts of you that move.

lines.zh: 你不属于这条气味线。
lines.en: You do not belong to this scent line.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住了巢口的沙。
lines.en: Your shadow covers the sand at the nest mouth.

lines.zh: 我不喊，巢里已经知道你来了。
lines.en: I do not call out; the hive already knows.

lines.zh: 你看不见我们，我们看得见你。
lines.en: You cannot see us, but we see you.

lines.zh: 你的脚步太重，震得隧道掉沙。
lines.en: Your steps are heavy enough to shake sand loose.

lines.zh: 你往后退一步，我就往前一步。
lines.en: You step back once, I step forward once.

lines.zh: 你没有翅膀，却敢站在沙上。
lines.en: Wingless, and yet you stand on the sand.

lines.zh: 我在等巢里的回音，决定你算什么。
lines.en: I wait for the hive to say what you are.

lines.zh: 你手里的火把，让我的眼睛发疼。
lines.en: The torch in your hand makes my eyes ache.

lines.zh: 你转身的时候，我会记住你的方向。
lines.en: When you turn, I will remember which way.

lines.zh: 别数我们，我们比你想的多。
lines.en: Do not count us; there are more than you think.

lines.zh: 我数你眨眼的次数，一次不多。
lines.en: I count your blinks. Not one extra.

lines.zh: 你手里的灯晃，我的影子也跟着晃。
lines.en: Your lamp swings, and so does my shadow.

lines.zh: 你踩进隧道，队形就换了一种。
lines.en: You step into the tunnel, and the formation changes.

lines.zh: 我看你的鞋底，那里有泥也有血。
lines.en: I look at your soles. There's mud and blood.

lines.zh: 壳裂了一道，我听得见。
lines.en: My shell has split; I can hear it.

lines.zh: 我退进隧道，把伤口贴在沙上。
lines.en: I back into the tunnel and press the wound to the sand.

lines.zh: 这一下不算重，我还能走。
lines.en: That was not heavy; I can still walk.

lines.zh: 疼痛是巢的信号，我传下去了。
lines.en: Pain is a signal to the hive; I passed it on.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，沙从缝里掉出来。
lines.en: I shake, and sand falls from the seams.

lines.zh: 你打断了我的一条腿，路还认。
lines.en: You broke a leg; I still know the way.

lines.zh: 我转身的原因不是怕。
lines.en: I did not turn because I was afraid.

lines.zh: 血是淡色的，落在沙里看不见。
lines.en: My blood is pale and vanishes in the sand.

lines.zh: 我压低了身体，这样更难被打到。
lines.en: I keep low, so I am harder to hit.

lines.zh: 巢里收到消息了，你等着。
lines.en: The hive has the message now; wait.

lines.zh: 食物不归我管，我只负责把它围住。
lines.en: Food is not mine to take; I only surround it.

lines.zh: 你举着东西，巢里已经在商量了。
lines.en: You hold it up, and the hive is already deciding.

lines.zh: 我不吃，我只把气味带回去。
lines.en: I do not eat it; I carry the smell back.

lines.zh: 你放下它，会有人来搬。
lines.en: Put it down, and someone will come for it.

lines.zh: 这味道进了隧道，就收不回去了。
lines.en: That smell is in the tunnel now; it cannot be taken back.

lines.zh: 我不上前，前面的位置有人占着。
lines.en: I hold back; the front place is taken.

lines.zh: 你把食物举高，我就抬头看。
lines.en: Lift the food higher and I will look up.

lines.zh: 蜂蚁不挑食，只挑落单的。
lines.en: Swarmers are not picky; we only pick the isolated.

lines.zh: 那东西掉在沙上，我记下了位置。
lines.en: It fell on the sand; I have marked where.

lines.zh: 我不碰，碰了就是我的错。
lines.en: I will not touch it; touching makes it my fault.

lines.zh: 撞我一下，队形就断了。
lines.en: One bump from you and the column breaks.

lines.zh: 我的壳比看起来硬，你不必道歉。
lines.en: My shell is harder than it looks; no apology needed.

lines.zh: 你踩到的是通道，不是空地。
lines.en: You stepped on a passage, not open ground.

lines.zh: 我退开半步，气味线没断。
lines.en: I give half a step; the scent line holds.

lines.zh: 肩膀撞肩膀，巢里管这叫让路。
lines.en: Shoulder against shoulder; the hive calls that yielding.

lines.zh: 你太重，沙子都震到隧道里了。
lines.en: You are heavy enough to shake sand into the tunnels.

lines.zh: 撞完记得别停，停下就被围住。
lines.en: After the bump, keep moving, or you get surrounded.

lines.zh: 我贴着你绕过去，脚没乱。
lines.en: I slip around you without breaking stride.

lines.zh: 这一下不是攻击，是让你退。
lines.en: That was no attack; it was a warning to back off.

lines.zh: 通道窄，我们从来不并排走。
lines.en: The passage is narrow; we never walk side by side.

lines.zh: 繁殖不是我的事，我只守巢口。
lines.en: Breeding is not my work; I only guard the entrance.

lines.zh: 巢里只有一位在产卵，我们都清楚。
lines.en: Only one in the hive lays eggs, and we all know it.

lines.zh: 我把卵递进保育室，然后离开。
lines.en: I pass the eggs into the nursery, then leave.

lines.zh: 我的血统没有名字，只有气味。
lines.en: My line has no name, only a smell.

lines.zh: 有人问过我的父母，我答不上来。
lines.en: Someone asked about my parents; I had no answer.

lines.zh: 幼虫的房间里，谁都不能久留。
lines.en: No one lingers long in the larvae room.

lines.zh: 我不配对，我只护送。
lines.en: I do not pair; I only escort.

lines.zh: 巢里的幼体都是一样的白。
lines.en: The hive's young are all the same white.

lines.zh: 我认得那位的气味，别的都不必。
lines.en: I know her scent; nothing else is required.

lines.zh: 我这一生不会有自己的巢室。
lines.en: I will never have a chamber of my own.

lines.zh: 我不搬东西，劳工才搬。
lines.en: I do not carry; the workers carry.

lines.zh: 那粒种子归粮仓，不归我。
lines.en: That seed belongs to the store, not to me.

lines.zh: 我抬起来的只有我的脚。
lines.en: The only thing I lift is my own foot.

lines.zh: 路过掉落的食物，我不停。
lines.en: I pass fallen food without stopping.

lines.zh: 集会让我空着手，这是规矩。
lines.en: The swarm keeps my hands empty; that is the rule.

lines.zh: 你想让我捡，得先问过巢。
lines.en: If you want me to pick it up, ask the hive first.

lines.zh: 我碰过的东西，会沾上气味。
lines.en: Anything I touch picks up my scent.

lines.zh: 地上那点碎屑，留给后面的。
lines.en: Those crumbs stay for whoever comes after.

lines.zh: 我没有口袋，也没有要装的东西。
lines.en: I have no pocket and nothing to put in one.

lines.zh: 捡东西的活，轮不到蜂蚁。
lines.en: Fetching is never a swarmer's job.

lines.zh: 那条气味线断了，我知道是谁踩的。
lines.en: The scent line is broken; I know who stepped on it.

lines.zh: 沙面上多了一道新脚印。
lines.en: A new footprint has appeared on the sand.

lines.zh: 巢口有一只脚踩进来，我看见了。
lines.en: A foot came down at the entrance; I saw it.

lines.zh: 目标在动，周围就没有别的了。
lines.en: The target moves, and nothing else matters.

lines.zh: 我不急，巢里已经在调人了。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; the hive is already moving kin.

lines.zh: 你踩塌的那一小块，我记着。
lines.en: I remember the patch of tunnel you collapsed.

lines.zh: 凡是靠近巢口的，先算敌人。
lines.en: Anyone near the entrance counts as an enemy first.

lines.zh: 我看见火光在隧道口晃。
lines.en: I see torchlight swaying at the tunnel mouth.

lines.zh: 这一只落单了，可以围。
lines.en: This one is alone; it can be surrounded.

lines.zh: 目标一旦转身，方向就定了。
lines.en: Once the target turns, its direction is settled.

lines.zh: 你的味道太浓，藏不住的。
lines.en: Your smell is too strong to hide.

lines.zh: 巢的边界就在你脚下。
lines.en: The hive's border is right under your feet.

lines.zh: 我敲了两下墙，附近都醒了。
lines.en: I tapped the wall twice; the nearby ones are awake.

lines.zh: 从这一格沙开始，都算我们的地。
lines.en: From this patch of sand on, the ground is ours.

lines.zh: 你的气味进了保育室，我们全知道了。
lines.en: Your scent reached the nursery. We all know.

lines.zh: 这一只走得太深，回不去了。
lines.en: This one has gone too deep. No way back.

lines.zh: 我不追，我等你走过来。
lines.en: I do not chase; I wait for you to come closer.

lines.zh: 三只走前面，四只堵在后面。
lines.en: Three go in front, four block the back.

lines.zh: 我的位置是左翼，别挤我。
lines.en: I hold the left flank; do not crowd me.

lines.zh: 你在往沙里陷，我们不用费力。
lines.en: You are sinking in the sand; we need not strain.

lines.zh: 我沿着你的影子走，很省力。
lines.en: I walk along your shadow; it costs me little.

lines.zh: 隧道里都让开了，给你留了路。
lines.en: The tunnel has opened up; a path is left for you.

lines.zh: 我不叫，叫了你会跑得更快。
lines.en: I stay silent; noise would only make you run.

lines.zh: 你每退一步，包围就收紧一点。
lines.en: Every step you retreat, the ring tightens.

lines.zh: 我听见你的呼吸乱了。
lines.en: I hear your breathing fall out of rhythm.

lines.zh: 我们换位置，不换目标。
lines.en: We change places, never the target.

lines.zh: 沙里的震动替我报方位。
lines.en: The tremors in the sand report your position.

lines.zh: 你抬头看的时候，我们从地面来。
lines.en: While you look up, we come along the ground.

lines.zh: 这个距离，我只需要等巢的口令。
lines.en: At this range I only need the hive's word.

lines.zh: 你选错了一边，那边薄。
lines.en: You picked the wrong side; that one is thin.

lines.zh: 我把你往窄的一头赶，那里好围。
lines.en: I drive you toward the narrow end. Easier to surround.

lines.zh: 我数着你的退路，还剩两条。
lines.en: I count your escape routes. Two left.

lines.zh: 我从顶上爬，你只看得到地面。
lines.en: I climb along the ceiling. You watch the ground.

lines.zh: 你停下喘气的时候，我们也在停。
lines.en: When you stop to breathe, we stop too.

lines.zh: 我只是咬住不放，别的交给别人。
lines.en: I only bite and hold; the rest is for others.

lines.zh: 颚一合，沙就混进你的袖口。
lines.en: My jaws close, and sand gets into your sleeve.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，重量比你想的多。
lines.en: I leap, and I weigh more than you expect.

lines.zh: 这一口不深，够你记住。
lines.en: This bite is shallow, but you will remember it.

lines.zh: 我撕的是布，不是骨头。
lines.en: It is cloth I tear, not bone.

lines.zh: 六只脚一起抓住，你甩不掉。
lines.en: Six feet grip at once; you cannot shake me.

lines.zh: 我咬完就退，后面还有一只。
lines.en: I bite and withdraw; another is behind me.

lines.zh: 你把火把扔了，我就靠近。
lines.en: Drop the torch and I will come closer.

lines.zh: 我们的攻击是一阵，不是一下。
lines.en: Our attack is a wave, not a single blow.

lines.zh: 我专挑手腕，那里动得少。
lines.en: I go for the wrist, where you move least.

lines.zh: 咬下去时，我听见巢在叫。
lines.en: As I bite, I hear the hive calling.

lines.zh: 你抬手挡，正好挡住眼睛。
lines.en: You raise an arm to block, and blind yourself.

lines.zh: 我只负责第一口，第二口有别人。
lines.en: I take the first bite; the second belongs to another.

lines.zh: 沙粘在伤口上，这里没有水洗。
lines.en: Sand sticks to the wound; there is no water here.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的腰带，往巢里拖。
lines.en: I bite your belt and drag you toward the nest.

lines.zh: 我的颚卡在护腕上，越咬越深。
lines.en: My jaw is stuck in your bracer, biting deeper.

lines.zh: 我从巢壁的裂缝里爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out through a crack in the hive wall.

lines.zh: 没有刷怪蛋，我本来就在这。
lines.en: No spawn egg made me; I was already here.

lines.zh: 第一批出生在保育室最里面。
lines.en: The first of us were born deep in the nursery.

lines.zh: 我睁开眼，先学会闻，再学会走。
lines.en: I opened my eyes, learned to smell, then to walk.

lines.zh: 沙面第一次塌下来，我在下面。
lines.en: The first time the sand caved in, I was beneath it.

lines.zh: 巢里给我留了一个位置，很窄。
lines.en: The hive left me a place, and it is narrow.

lines.zh: 出来时壳还是软的，走得很慢。
lines.en: My shell was still soft, so I walked slowly.

lines.zh: 我被推上通道，前面全是脚。
lines.en: I was pushed into the passage, all feet ahead of me.

lines.zh: 头顶的沙漏下来，我知道天亮了。
lines.en: Sand seeped from above; I knew the day had come.

lines.zh: 没有谁宣布我的到来，我只是一只。
lines.en: No one announced me; I am simply one more.

lines.zh: 队伍从我身上跨过去，我跟上了。
lines.en: The column stepped over me, and I followed.

lines.zh: 隧道尽头有光，那不是出口，是陷阱。
lines.en: Light at the tunnel's end is a trap, not an exit.

lines.zh: 我出生时数过一次同类，数不完。
lines.en: Once, at birth, I counted my kin and could not finish.

lines.zh: 巢让我先站在最外圈。
lines.en: The hive set me in the outermost ring.

lines.zh: 我从卵里挣出来，脚还不会走。
lines.en: I struggle out of the egg. My legs don't know how to walk.

lines.zh: 巢壁的泥还是软的，我爬得很慢。
lines.en: The nest wall is still soft. I climb slowly.

lines.zh: 第一批同伴把我挤到外圈。
lines.en: The first batch of kin pushed me to the outer ring.

lines.zh: 没有人给我名字，只有一条气味线。
lines.en: Nobody gave me a name, only a scent line.

lines.zh: 火把燎过我的翅膀，焦味很重。
lines.en: The torch sears my wing; the burnt smell is thick.

lines.zh: 从隧道顶摔下来，我翻了个身。
lines.en: I fell from the tunnel roof and rolled over once.

lines.zh: 沙洞进了水，我的气孔灌满了。
lines.en: Water filled the sand burrow and flooded my spiracles.

lines.zh: 冲击把整段通道掀开了。
lines.en: The blast tore a whole stretch of tunnel open.

lines.zh: 那根箭钉在我的背上，我拖着走。
lines.en: The arrow is stuck in my back; I drag it along.

lines.zh: 有东西绕过我的壳，直接烧里面。
lines.en: Something went past my shell and burned inside.

lines.zh: 粮仓空了三天，我的腿发软。
lines.en: The store has been empty three days; my legs feel weak.

lines.zh: 雷落在沙上，我的触角还在麻。
lines.en: Lightning struck the sand; my antennae still tingle.

lines.zh: 我掉出了巢，往下没有底。
lines.en: I fell out of the hive, into a bottomless drop.
